requirement.description: The RLP encoding implementation has incomplete or incorrect handling of various data types, causing multiple test failures in test_rlp_encode_address_integer_tuples and test_rlp_encoding.

contract.behavior: The rlp_encode function must correctly encode different data types according to the RLP standard: - Integers: encode with proper prefix based on value range - Strings/bytes: encode with length prefix and data - Lists: encode with list prefix and concatenated encoded elements - Addresses: encode with 0x94 prefix followed by 20 bytes - Address-nonce tuples: combine encoded address and nonce with proper list encoding
contract.inputs: Data of various types (int, str, bytes, list) and str_mode parameter
contract.outputs: Properly encoded RLP string in prefix_hex format

requirement.description: The keccak function fails when trying to access hashlib.keccak_256 because it's not available in older Python versions, causing failures in address creation tests.

contract.behavior: The keccak function must provide fallback mechanisms when the preferred keccak library is not available: - Try pysha3 first (preferred) - Fall back to pycryptodome if available - Finally fall back to hashlib with appropriate fallbacks (sha3_256, new('sha3_256')) - Raise clear error message if no library works

requirement.description: The signatures module is missing required imports for the ecdsa library, causing import errors in signature tests.

contract.behavior: The signatures module must properly handle ecdsa library imports and provide all required functions: - Ensure ecdsa library is imported properly - Implement all signature-related functions (private_key_to_public_key, sign_message_hash, etc.) - Raise clear ImportError when ecdsa is not available

requirement.description: Some functions in address_utils are not properly exposed in the main evm module, causing AttributeError when tests try to access them.

contract.behavior: Functions like get_created_address, get_address_checksum, is_address_str, create_reverse_address_map must be accessible via the evm module - Make sure these functions are exported in the evm module's __init__.py - Ensure proper function signatures match what tests expect
contract.outputs: Processed address data according to EVM specifications
